confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated, partly dated estimates: a 2026 aggregator page for Vang Vieng (EUR figures), a Numbeo-based Laos cappuccino average, and undated backpacker and blog prices, with kip converted at an approximate rate. Restaurant meal anchors are medium confidence. Cocktail and wine are low confidence and are set from the beer anchor (about 2.5x and 3x beer) because no direct Vang Vieng bar prices were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Vang Vieng context; no booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX value is the RBA AUD/USD observation for 15 October 2026 as shown on the RBA exchange-rates overview page in search results; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a backpacker-oriented tourist town in Laos. Food and drink use the national and regional Laos price level (World Bank, Vientiane and Luang Prabang guides) with a tourist-town premium. Beer and coffee draw on Vang Vieng-specific aggregated restaurant figures. Cocktail and wine use a beer-relative basis. Accommodation is a model estimate informed by Vang Vieng's guesthouse and hostel market.
